name: Investment Fund Transactions By Fund 2
definition: Investment fund transactions for a specific financial instrument.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification of a security by an ISIN.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name of the financial instrument in free format text.

SupplementaryIdentification.name: Supplementary Identification
SupplementaryIdentification.definition: Additional information about a financial instrument to help identify the instrument.

SecuritiesForm.name: Securities Form
SecuritiesForm.definition: Form, ie, ownership, of the security, eg, registered or bearer.

ClassType.name: Class Type
ClassType.definition: Features of units offered by a fund. For example, a unit may have a specific load structure, eg, front end or back end, an income policy, eg, pay out or accumulate, or a trailer policy, eg, with or without. Fund classes are typically denoted by a single character, eg, 'Class A', 'Class 2'.

DistributionPolicy.name: Distribution Policy
DistributionPolicy.definition: Income policy relating to a class type, ie, if income is paid out or retained in the fund.

TransactionDetails.name: Transaction Details
TransactionDetails.definition: Process of buying, selling, switching or transferring fund units.

BalanceByPage.name: Balance By Page
BalanceByPage.definition: Balance of the financial instrument for this specific statement page.
